page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a frequency of 2.5 GHz, this instance features 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The server includes no local disk storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system and data retention, and contains zero integrated GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 2.0 GB per vCPU memory capacity prioritizes processing power over large memory pools, providing strong resource density for compute-bound operations. Relying exclusively on external block storage introduces a tradeoff by depending on network storage performance for disk I/O. This hardware profile provides favorable qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require high parallel processing capability without substantial memory allocation. Ideal operational applications include web application serving, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, batch data processing, software compilation, and ETL tasks.
